lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular lattice of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region, concentrated along the horizontal axis of the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity originating from the gill region and extending dorsally, intersecting with circular spot clusters to form a coordinate-like grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear horizontal feature in the superior third of the visible flank, defined by a distinct vertical luminance gradient with shadow-casting along the inferior edge.
